package main
import (
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "strings"
 "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rules/boundaries"
)
func main() {
 data,err:=os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]);if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 count:=0
 for _,row:=range strings.Split(string(data),"\n") {if row=="" {continue};fields:=strings.Split(row,"\t");output,refused:=boundaries.OwnedBoundaryDecision(fields[0],fields[1],fields[2]);if refused {count++};if len(os.Args)<3 {fmt.Print(output)}}
 if len(os.Args)>2 {fmt.Println(count)}
}
